entry.title: On some conjectures of Z.-W. Sun involving harmonic numbers
entry.summary: Harmonic numbers are significant in various branches of number theory. With the help of the digamma function, we prove ten conjectural series of Z.-W. Sun involving harmonic numbers. Several ones of them are also series expansions of $\log2/π^2$.

entry.title: On series identities involving $\binom{4k}k$ and harmonic numbers
entry.summary: The harmonic numbers are those $H_n=\sum_{0<k\le n}\frac1k\ (n=0,1,2,\ldots)$. In this paper we confirm over ten conjectural series identities with summands involving the binomial coefficient $\binom{4k}k$ and harmonic numbers. For example, we prove the identities $$\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{\binom{4k}{k}}{16^k}\left((22k^2-92k+11)H_{4k}-\frac{449k-275}{2}-\frac{85}{12k}\right)=-151-\frac{80}{3}\log{2}$$ and $$ \sum_{k=0}^\infty\frac{\binom{4k}{k}((11k^2+8k+1)(10H_{4k}-17H_{2k})+2k+18)}{(3k+1)(3k+2)16^k}=8\log2,$$ which were previously conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.

entry.title: Taylor coefficients and series involving harmonic numbers
entry.summary: During 2022--2023 Z.-W. Sun posed many conjectures on infinite series with summands involving generalized harmonic numbers. Motivated by this, we deduce $58$ series identities involving harmonic numbers, eight of which were previously conjectured by the second author. For example, we obtain that \[ \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^k}{k^2{2k \choose k}{3k \choose k}} \left( \frac{7 k-2}{2 k-1} H_{k-1}^{(2)}-\frac{3}{4 k^2} \right) = \frac{π^4}{720}. \] and \[ \sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{k^2 {2k \choose k}^2} \left( \frac{30k-11}{k(2k-1)} (H_{2k-1}^{(3)} + 2 H_{k-1}^{(3)}) + \frac{27}{8k^4} \right) = 4 ζ(3)^2, \] where $H_n^{(m)}$ denotes $\sum_{0<j \le n}j^{-m}$.

entry.title: Sun's Three Conjectures on Apéry-like Sums Involving Harmonic Numbers
entry.summary: In this paper, we will give another proof of Zhi-Wei Sun's three conjectures on Apéry-like sums involving harmonic numbers by proving some identities among special values of multiple polylogarithms.

entry.title: A Note on Sun's Conjectures on Apéry-like Sums Involving Lucas Sequences and Harmonic Numbers
entry.summary: In this paper, we will prove Zhi-Wei Sun's four conjectural identities on Apéry-like sums involving Lucas sequences and harmonic numbers by using a few results of Davydychev--Kalmykov.
entry.arxiv:journal_ref: J. Combinat. and Number Thy. Vol. 12 (3)(2023), pp. 209-216
